description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing scheduler configurations, including UE creation, reconfiguration, deletion, and cell management within the scheduler. Contains event classes for UE configuration updates and deletions, and a manager class for handling these operations.

classes.name: ue_config_update_event
classes.description: Represents an event to create or reconfigure a UE in the scheduler.

classes.name: ue_config_delete_event
classes.description: Represents an event to delete a UE from the scheduler.

classes.name: sched_ue_configuration_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling creation, reconfiguration, and deletion of UE configurations.

classes.name: sched_config_manager
classes.description: Manages creation, update, and removal of cell and UE configurations within the scheduler.

methods.name: sched_config_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler configuration manager with scheduler settings and metrics handler.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell configuration based on the provided request message.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the scheduler by its index.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates a new UE configuration event.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the scheduler.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a cell index is present in the scheduler.

methods.name: get_cell_group_index
methods.description: Retrieves the cell group index for a given cell or UE.

methods.name: get_pcell_index
methods.description: Gets the primary cell index associated with a UE.

methods.name: get_cell_group_index (overload)
methods.description: Gets the cell group index for a UE based on its index.

methods.name: common_cell_list
methods.description: Returns the list of common cell configurations.
